notes.title: this House v2 update!
notes.content: v2 Includes improved performance and bug fixes!

notes.title: V1.55 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where Madam Sandra would ask you to read the piano book, even when you didn't have it.

Do read it though when you get it because it will help!

notes.title: this House V1.5 now live
notes.content:
Hello! V.1.5 is now live. Here is what has been changed/fixed:

[list]
[*]Fixed and issue where Madam Sandra would keep giving you the same hint
[*]Added more autosave points
[*]Added better instructions on how to save your game!
[/list]

notes.title: this House V1.45 patch now live!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
[list]
[*]A hint has been added to help you ignite the fireplace [i]Use the rat poison![/i]
[*]It is now easier to navigate the forest!
[*]More Madam Sandra hints added! [i]Don't forget to talk to her![/i]
[*]Clearer instructions on how to use the goggles [i](Walk into the water....)[/i]
[*]Some minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: v1.16
notes.content:
Added the ability to change the keyboard controls :-)

Good times.
